independent_cpu_check.interpretation: Independent NumPy binary64 trigonometry applied to captured GPU angles explains the strict-oracle difference within the separately reported residual. This reduces risk of an indexing/rotation defect for this fixture; it is not a whole-model, long-position or gradient certification.

recommendation: Keep the frozen runtime arithmetic for the controlled M5 run rather than silently replacing its RoPE formula or loosening the historical test. Preserve the failed strict result and use fresh M5 comparisons under one pinned TF32-disabled mode. Complete full-item preflight before training.

research_review.conclusion: The cited sources support execution-grounded tasks, precise problem statements, validated feedback and careful masks; they do not establish this20%diagnostic ratio, final-layer recipe or Metal improvement. The draft explicitly states these limits. Other listed papers were not independently re-reviewed in this bounded pass.

evaluation_scope: Same16heldout token IDs/masks and per-category loss; added code separate from serialization and rationale.

Eight label decisions from five related protected families assess narrow recognition, not free-form reasoning; two expression completions assess bounded correctness, not full agent edits or optimization speed.
New corpus+moreupdates+changed learning rate is a whole-recipe comparison, not isolated data-quality causality.
